question: What is the meaning of bill of materials in relation to unique product identifiers, general information?
description: A bill of materials (BOM) is a list of the raw materials, sub-assemblies, intermediate assemblies, sub-components, components, and the quantities of each needed to manufacture an end product. In the context of unique product identifiers and general information, a BOM can serve as a unique identifier for a product, providing detailed information about the materials and components used in its production. This information can be linked to a materials passport, enabling the tracking and management of materials throughout their life cycle.
